papers.title_en: A-SR: Self-Evolving Agentic LLMs for Symbolic Regression via Hierarchical Coordination
papers.authors: Wenxiao Zhao, Dong Liu, Kaiyi Xu, Feng Liu, Zhen Zhao, Fei Ben, Shu Wang, Wenhao Li, Yingnian Wu, Fenghua Ling, Haobo Li, Lei Bai
papers.evidence: 提出一种自进化的智能体LLM框架，具有分层协调和角色条件化进化
papers.tldr: 符号回归旨在从数据中自动发现闭合形式方程，但现有基于LLM的方法将异构搜索失败简化为单一标量评分和统一提示，忽略失败类型的多样性。A-SR提出自演化的代理式框架，将控制逻辑从表达式编辑转移到角色条件证据视图，通过协调协议路由、在线评估者-奖励策略和状态路由过程记忆，实现公式发现的分工协作。在运行内，它无需更新LLM参数即可自适应搜索；跨运行，可将轨迹蒸馏至开源LLM，获得角色条件提议先验。在LLM-SRBench四个科学领域上，A-SR将Acc@0.01从25.79%提升至48.30%（Llama3.1-8B），A-SR-LoRA提升Qwen3-4B至38.29%；在四个真实任务上，8个指标中7个获得最优标准化均方误差。该框架通过层次化协调与自演化，显著提升了符号回归的发现精度与效率，并开辟了LLM代理在科学计算中的新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression aims to discover closed-form equations from data, but existing LLM-guided methods often rely on a unified proposal loop that compresses heterogeneous search failures into a scalar score and a single prompt. We propose A-SR, a self-evolving agentic framework that shifts the control unit from expression edits to role-conditioned evidence views. A-SR coordinates formula discovery through routing among coordination protocols, an online evaluator-reward role policy, and state-routed process memory. During search, evaluator feedback characterizes reliability and productivity, updates role-level utilities, and routes elite motifs, failure traces, and validity diagnostics to different agents. The framework self-evolves at two timescales: within a run, it adapts the search process without updating LLM parameters; across runs, recorded trajectories can be distilled into open-source LLMs as role-conditioned proposal priors. Averaged over the four LSR-Synth scientific domains in LLM-SRBench, A-SR improves Acc@0.01 over baselines from 25.79% to 48.30% with Llama3.1-8B, while A-SR-LoRA improves the corresponding Qwen3-4B result from 24.58% to 38.29%. On four real-world scientific discovery tasks, A-SR obtains the best in-distribution or out-of-distribution normalized mean squared error on 7 of 8 reported metrics.

papers.title_en: Causal Episodic Memory for Feedback-Driven Agent Repair
papers.authors: Khang Nhat Hoang Vo, Tam Minh Chu, Anh Trac Duc Dinh, Thuyen Vinh Ha Bui, Tho Quan
papers.evidence: 免训练的代理，利用情景记忆在Text-to-SQL任务中自我修复，是一种NLP自进化方法
papers.tldr: LLM代理修复失败时常丢弃成功修正，迫使后续查询重复探索解决方案。MERIT提出一种无训练的在线记忆机制，利用oracle验证的修正与失败方向构建双极性记忆，通过失败类型分类和混合检索引导修复。在Spider上准确率升至69.79%，BIRD升至48.44%，但优势有限，局部模式经验益处最一致。研究揭示了跨查询因果记忆何时提升修复效果。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents that repair failures often discard successful corrections, forcing later episodes to rediscover similar solutions. We study whether finalized repair outcomes can improve subsequent Text-to-SQL episodes without parameter updates. We introduce MERIT, a training-free agent that maintains an online dual-polarity memory of oracle-verified corrections and observed unsuccessful directions. Under oracle-assisted benchmark feedback, only memories from earlier finalized episodes are eligible for retrieval. A deterministic classifier assigns a coarse failure type, which conditions a hybrid lexical-dense retriever before the frozen model generates each revision. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with identical initial predictions and repair budgets, MERIT improves execution accuracy over stateless iterative repair from \(66.34\%\) to \(69.79\%\) on Spider and from \(47.35\%\) to \(48.44\%\) on BIRD. Paired analyses provide clear evidence for the Spider gain but weaker evidence on BIRD. MERIT is not reliably separated from untyped dynamic retrieval on either benchmark, while Reflexion-style memory reaches \(51.24\%\) on BIRD at substantially higher inference cost. Ablations show that negative memory contributes modestly, the value of type conditioning and lexical--dense ranking is dataset dependent, and schema-local experience provides the most consistent benefit. These results clarify when causal cross-query memory improves repair and when broader memory representations remain preferable.

papers.title_en: Hyper-ES: Effective Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning via Descent Direction Merging
papers.authors: Yu Gu, Zhi Zheng, Yunpeng Ba, Xialiang Tong, Mingxuan Yuan, Zhenkun Wang
papers.evidence: 用进化策略微调LLM进行推理
papers.tldr: 在大语言模型推理中，全参数进化策略因高维空间随机扰动与有用更新方向近乎正交而失效。Hyper-ES先通过少量梯度微调获取下降方向，将其张成低维适应子空间，再利用CMA-ES优化层间DARE-TIES合并系数，使进化策略在子空间内搜索方向组合。在六个数学推理数据集上，Hyper-ES比GRPO-LoRA提升1%，且所需梯度更新减少10%。该方法为资源受限场景提供了高效进化策略优化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Evolution Strategy (ES) is a promising alternative to gradient-based fine-tuning for resource-constrained Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. However, directly applying ES to billion-parameter LLMs is highly ineffective. In such high-dimensional parameter spaces, most random perturbations are nearly orthogonal to useful update directions, leading to unstable optimization. We propose Hyper-ES, a subspace-based ES framework that avoids the weakness of ES in full-parameter search while exploiting its strength in low-dimensional optimization. Instead of asking ES to discover useful directions from random perturbations in the LLM parameter space, Hyper-ES first performs a small number of inexpensive gradient-based fine-tuning runs to obtain descent directions. Although each direction may provide only a limited improvement on its own, their span forms a compact adaptation subspace that captures useful reasoning updates. Hyper-ES then applies CMA-ES to optimize layer-wise DARE-TIES merging coefficients within this subspace, allowing ES to search over combinations of meaningful descent directions rather than over arbitrary full-model perturbations. We evaluate Hyper-ES on three Qwen2.5-Instruct and DeepSeek-R1-Distill backbones across six mathematical reasoning datasets. Results show that Hyper-ES consistently outperforms GRPO-LoRA by 1% while requiring 10% fewer space-consuming gradient updates. Code at https://github.com/kuangrepi/Hyper-ES.

papers.title_en: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows
papers.authors: Junbo Li, Boyi Liu, Canwen Xu, Yite Wang, Yuxiong He, Zhangyang Wang, Qiang Liu, Zhewei Yao
papers.evidence: 基于代理的推理驱动优化框架，自主进化提示、程序和ML工作流
papers.tldr: 传统优化系统依赖手工设计的外部控制器（如进化搜索、bandits），限制了搜索策略的灵活性和跨任务泛化。ReASearch将优化器构建为推理驱动的智能体，利用工具自主执行评估、诊断和编辑，并通过持久记忆动态分配预算和调整策略。在14项跨领域任务中，该框架全面超越专用基线，性能提升2%–40%，部分结果超越人类最佳。复杂搜索行为从智能体推理中自然涌现，表明推理驱动优化可统一多域自动化工作流。
papers.abstract_en: Recent systems for optimizing prompts, programs, and ML workflows typically rely on explicit outer-loop controllers such as evolutionary search, bandits, or textual-gradient methods. We ask a fundamentally different question: how much of this search policy can be internalized by a single tool-using agent? We present ReASearch, a unified framework for reasoning-driven optimization in which the agent autonomously decides what to evaluate, how to diagnose failures, which edits to make, and when to verify or restart. Rather than serving only as a proposal generator guided by hand-designed heuristics, the agent actively analyzes outcomes, allocates budget, and refines its strategy over long horizons through persistent memory. With a shared agent loop and domain-specific tools, ReASearch instantiates the exact same scaffold to optimize prompts, programs, and ML workflows. Across 14 diverse tasks, it is competitive with and mostly better than specialized optimization systems, achieving gains of 2% to 40% over strong domain-specific baselines, and in some cases discovering solutions that improve on prior human best-known results. Crucially, we observe that complex search behaviors, which are typically implemented by explicit controllers, emerge naturally from the agent's reasoning process.
